sources.supported_proposition_exactly: Available supporting evidence describes the official Iranian civil calendar as astronomically determined - the year beginning at the midnight nearest the vernal equinox observed at the Iranian reference meridian - rather than being governed by a closed-form arithmetic rule such as the repository library's fixed 33-year cycle.
sources.inference_limits: This is SECONDARY reference material, not an Iranian legal or standards text. It is sufficient to show that the repository library's 33-year arithmetic approximation cannot simply be ASSUMED to equal the official civil calendar, and therefore to keep the prerequisite blocked. It is NOT sufficient to positively and authoritatively define the official calendar rule, and it is not offered as independently resolved authoritative evidence.
sources.establishes: only the qualified proposition recorded in supported_proposition_exactly
sources.does_not_establish: an official, citable Iranian legal or standards text stating the civil calendar rule; that text was not retrieved. It also does not establish any specific divergence between the library approximation and the official calendar in any specific year.
